kanzAlMahalliRecord.statement: The record distinguishes residue passing to a functioning Bayt al-Mal from proportional radd to fixed-share heirs other than spouses when Bayt al-Mal is not properly functioning.

khulasaRecord.locator: references/source-notes/khulasa/khulasa-full.pdf; printed page 269; residue, Bayt al-Mal, and radd paragraph.
khulasaRecord.statement: A functioning Bayt al-Mal receives an unallocated estate or residue; when it is not functioning properly, surplus is returned proportionally to fixed-share heirs other than the spouses.

supportingSourceStatus: No project-local Fath al-Mu‘in locator was available, so none is asserted.
ruleSummary: Resolve qualifying residue by an explicitly selected Bayt al-Mal policy; never infer the policy from an ordinary charity.
conditions: A positive residue remains after valid fixed shares.
No eligible residuary has a prior claim to that residue.
The remainder-policy input is explicitly FUNCTIONING_BAYT_AL_MAL or NO_FUNCTIONING_BAYT_AL_MAL_RADD.
exclusions: Spouses do not receive radd under the no-functioning-Bayt-al-Mal branch.
UNSURE is not a fiqh outcome and must stop calculation without selecting either branch.
An ordinary charity is not established by either source as equivalent to Bayt al-Mal.
Dhawu al-arham treatment after absence of eligible fixed-share heirs is outside the functional MVP.
blockingAndPriorityInteractions: Apply fixed shares and every eligible residuary before this rule.
The two policy branches are mutually exclusive.
For radd, remove spouse shares from the proportional redistribution base.

sourceAgreement.detail: Both Shafi‘i sources preserve the functioning-Bayt-al-Mal rule and the no-functioning-Bayt-al-Mal radd branch, including spouse exclusion from radd.

unresolvedQuestions: Dhawu al-arham sequencing is not admitted in this MVP.
Institutional criteria for deciding whether a Bayt al-Mal is functioning remain an external case fact.

atomicCandidateAssessment.rationale: The two source-supported branches have distinct conditions and outcomes and must remain separate atoms.

admissionBlockers: Exact fixtures, interaction tests, and a separate calculation-readiness admission are still required.
